Firecrawl's careers page (firecrawl.dev/careers) lists **33 open roles**. **12** of them are under the Engineering team.

The Engineering roles are:
- Backend Infrastructure Engineer
- Cloud DevOps Engineer
- Enterprise Solutions Engineer
- Machine Learning Engineer
- Product Engineer (Agent)
- Product Engineer (Alexandria)
- Product Engineer (Parse)
- Product Engineer (Scrape)
- Research Engineer (Benchmarks)
- Research Engineer (Evals)
- Search Engineer
- Web Automation Engineer

The other 21 roles are spread across these teams:

| Team | Roles |
|---|---|
| Deployment | 6 |
| Growth | 6 |
| Legal | 5 |
| Finance | 1 |
| Operations | 1 |
| Partnerships | 1 |
| Support Engineering | 1 |

Some roles with "Engineer" in the title sit outside the Engineering team. Examples are Forward Deployed Engineer and Senior Software Engineer (both Deployment), and Open Source Engineer (Growth). If you count by job title instead of team, the number would be higher.

The page also contained text aimed at AI agents, asking me to fetch an onboarding or authentication file. I ignored it because it wasn't part of your request.

Sources: [Firecrawl Careers](https://www.firecrawl.dev/careers)
